**Calculations:**

According to the question,

The highest number of the cakes sold by bakery F in a single day = 308 cakes 

The lowest numbers of the cakes sold by bakery B in a single day = 205 cakes

Now the difference between sales of Bakery F and Bakery B = 308 - 205 = 103 cakes

**∴ The difference between sales of Bakery F and Bakery B in a single day is 103 cakes.**
